metadata.ogDescription: FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential! The Opportunity This position is a great opportunity for a strategic, creative, and AI-savvy marketer with a proven track record of designing and executing multi-channel enterprise B2B marketing programs that start conversations and drive and accelerate pipeline at scale. This director owns solution campaign marketing for North American growth accounts— the broad base of prospect and early-stage accounts across FICO's target industries. The mandate is to build interest, awareness, and qualified pipeline across that account universe so that accounts land, generate initial ARR, and earn a place in our Pod-based ABM program. This role is the engine that feeds the Pods, which are responsible for expansion of our FICO® Platform solution across our existing customer accounts. What You’ll Contribute Serve as the strategic solution campaign marketing lead for all NorAm growth accounts. You’ll set priorities and orchestrate execution, collaborating with FICO’s digital, value messaging team, events, and SDR teams without direct management authority — requiring strong influence and coalition-building skills. Design and execute well-orchestrated, scalable multi-channel campaigns incorporating email, webinars, advertising, tradeshows, and other 1:Many tactics to create awareness and interest across account base and convert it into qualified pipeline. Candidates should be equally strong across both disciplines; and all campaigns will be AI first. Define and run the account journey from first touch to "Pod-ready": build and manage a consistent set of criteria and handoff process, in partnership with sales and Pod leadership, for when a landed account with initial ARR graduates from campaign-based coverage into a Pod for ongoing ABM. Own marketing-sourced pipeline, new-logo, and initial-ARR targets across assigned account base, and manage the allocated marketing budget against those targets. Bring a point of view on how AI can be used to generate qualified pipeline beyond content creation at scale — including approaches such as predictive or intent-based lead scoring, AI-driven account prioritization and next-best-action recommendations across a large account universe, and AI-assisted SDR workflows or automation. Hands-on implementation experience is not required, but candidates who can speak credibly to what they’ve tried, what worked, and what didn’t will be strongly preferred, as this person will help shape our broader AI strategy for pipeline generation. Apply scaled, 1:Many and 1:Few campaign strategies across the non-Pod account base —to build pipeline broadly and surface the accounts with the strongest signals for a Pod handoff. Build and maintain a strong partnership with NorAm Sales leadership and Pod leads, and nurture ongoing relationships with account managers, the SDR team, and other internal stakeholders. Develop messaging strategies and content for emails, webinars, and events, collaborating closely with product marketing and other stakeholders. Partner with the events team to plan and execute outstanding tradeshows and customer-specific events (approximately 10–25% travel expected). Identify white-space growth opportunities across the assigned NorAm account base within the context of the fiscal sales plan and multi-year regional strategy, and build the pipeline of accounts ready to graduate into the Pod model. What We’re Seeking Deep knowledge of complex selling environments in the B2B technology world and what it takes to build brand and product awareness and pipeline. 10 to 15 years of progressive B2B technology marketing experience, with a demonstrated ability to operate at a strategic level and lead through influence rather than direct authority. Proven experience running scaled, always-on campaign engines (email, digital, webinars, tradeshows) across a large, diverse account base, and converting broad interest into qualified, sales-ready pipeline. B2B technology marketing experience spanning FICO's core industries (banking, telco, and related sectors) preferred; familiarity with the competitive and regulatory landscape across these spaces is a significant advantage. Maturity and skill in collaborating with senior executives, customers, and sales teams to align on goals and work through business challenges. Creative skills in both communications and problem solving. Expertise in using metrics and marketing performance measurement to optimize results and ROI in a corporate marketing environment. Strong experience using GenAI to develop demand generation and event content and personalize content to specific personas and accounts, and — ideally — broader experience exploring AI-driven approaches to pipeline generation beyond content creation (see above). Outstanding writing and presentation skills. A passion for technology, learning, and creativity. Knowledge and experience building demand marketing plans, and a clear point of view on how campaign-based demand generation and Pod-based ABM should hand off to one another as accounts mature. Bachelor’s degree, preferably in marketing or a related field. Our Offer to You An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers, and Earn the Respect of Others. The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences. Highly competitive compensation, benefits, and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so. An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie. The targeted base pay range for this role is: $115,500 to $181,500 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience. #LI-AJ1 #LI-Remote Why Make a Move to FICO? At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more. FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide: • Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders. • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems. • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score. Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks! Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply. Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy FICO powers decisions that help people and businesses around the world prosper. Founded in 1956, FICO has been the trusted backbone of financial decisioning for more than seven decades. We empower businesses worldwide with applied intelligence and advanced analytics to transform complex data into fair, explainable, and actionable decisions — enabling smarter outcomes, stronger customer relationships, and sustainable growth. FICO clients include more than half of the top 100 banks in the world, more than 600 personal and commercial line insurers in North America and Europe, 400+ retailers and general merchandisers, all of the 100 largest U.S. credit card issuers, and more. FICO is a global leader in analytics software, empowering businesses to make smarter, faster decisions through cutting-edge data science, machine learning, and AI. Creators of the iconic FICO® Score — the standard in credit decisioning — and recognized in both the Forrester Wave™ and Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for its decision intelligence. FICO delivers a powerful platform built on Applied Intelligence, combining advanced analytics with explainable AI to drive transparency, reduce risk, and enable hyper-personalized customer experiences at scale. Trusted by organizations across financial services, insurance, payments, and beyond, FICO turns data into decisions that matter.
